about: Prodeus is a first-person shooter of old, re-imagined using modern rendering techniques and technology.
Experience the quality you’d expect from a modern AAA game, designed with retro aesthetics and gameplay that invoke the tech-imposed limits of older hardware.

The game features a hand-crafted campaign from industry FPS veterans, co-op and competitive multiplayer play drawing on classic modes*, a fully integrated level editor, and a built-in community map browser for instantaneous action with nearly…
Get ready to paint the walls red. This is the Boomer Shooter you’ve been waiting for.
Retro look, modern era Shooters past and present collide with graphics that combine today’s high-quality 3D tech with retro visuals.
summary: Resurrect the chaos of old-school first-person shooters
